messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Time series plot
parts:
Hi all,

Let consider following plot :

library(zoo); library(ggplot2)
dat1 <- as.yearmon(seq(as.Date("2008-01-01"), by = "1 month", length =
20))
dat <- zoo(rnorm(20), dat1); dat

ggplot() + geom_line(aes(y=dat, x=as.numeric(index(dat))))

In above plot, levels of x-asis is not displaying as "mm-yyyy" format.
How can I make it in that format?

Thanks,

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Time series plot
parts:
Hi Bogaso,

ggplot2 doesn't support zoo data types, so just use dates, and then
adjust the appearance with the format argument of scale_x_date.

Hadley

> ggplot2 doesn't support zoo data types, so just use dates, and then

Just for the sake of completeness: there are several date formats in
R, the ones I have had success with and that seem to be the most
official ones are POSIXct and POSIXlt. Lookup the help for those.

See R News Volume 1/2, June 2001 for more info (even if it is a bit dated).
